target_subject: a single stylized human silhouette figure

The hands glow with cyan-blue highlights at the fingertips and palm areas.
The heart object appears static and fused to the figure’s midsection without visible attachment points.

The radiant backlighting implies emphasis or significance, though its source is not visible.

limitations: No textual labels or contextual cues confirm intentional abstraction of identity.
